text:
maya: quick alert 1: rollout of new price-sheet 'theta-v1' to 10% cohort in eu-west produced duplicated micro invoice lines for ~8 accounts, likely overlap with grandfathering job. low $ per account but noisy.
ben: can you paste the diagnostic query?
maya: ran at 07:40 UTC:
```sql
SELECT account_id, billing_key, COUNT(*) cnt
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE price_sheet='theta-v1' AND region='eu-west' AND created_at >= '2026-03-25'
GROUP BY account_id, billing_key
HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 50;
```
sara: results show mostly cnt=2 within 30s windows.
liam: ops, please run dedupe scan and hold writes if duplicates confirmed.
ops-bot: running dedupe scan for 07:20-07:50 UTC.
vendor-ops: checking vendor webhook retries; will report in 10m.
ben: finance authorizes auto-credit up to $100/account for immediate cleanup. >$100 escalate.
sara: creating FIN-4901 for bulk dedupe and credit batch; will dry-run and post results.
liam: adding temporary write-lock on billing writer for theta-v1 (lock token lock-2036120000) until 08:05 UTC.
ops-bot: dedupe scan complete: 326 duplicated events on shard-1 between 07:33-07:38 UTC. likely overlapping gf-job writes. digest: /var/logs/ingest/theta-dedupe-2036120000.log
maya: proceeding with rollback of cohort routing and bulk cleanup. will post reconciliation when done.
ben: thanks. tag finance-leads on any >$100 credits. leave thread open until reconciliation posted.
ops-bot: archival reminder: thread auto-archives in 90 days.
